verdict.rationale: Data portability and avoiding lock-in are fair questions for a desktop operating system, so this axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of a capability to export user data in open formats or to migrate away. The closest item covers recovering data from hardware-backed disk encryption, which is a related recovery feature, not data export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
